what_works: Mood-coded color system — each use-case ('Socialize', 'Relax', 'Sleep') has its own assigned hue, turning the palette itself into navigation. Lifestyle photography matches the assigned mood color, reinforcing the system visually.
what_does_not_translate: Wellness/cannabis category-specific mood framing won't carry; the move that ports is 'one color per service category, photography color-matched to its slot.'
type_observations: Friendly contemporary sans-serif throughout; hierarchy via size rather than weight contrast. Type stays approachable, never aggressive.
